question: In the NYC Board of Education Retirement System (BERS) RFP 2024-003 for investment consulting services, how many maximum evaluation points are assigned to the annual fee proposal?
gold_answer: 28 points (out of 100). Full breakdown: Program Plan/Narrative 18, Organizational Capacity/Knowledge and Experience 23, Demonstrated Effectiveness 22, Fee Proposal - Annual Fee 28, Fee Proposal - Hourly Rate 9.
gold_passage: Evaluation Points = Lowest Estimated Total Contract Amount (divided by (/)) Proposer’s Estimated Total Contract Amount (multiplied by (x)) Maximum Points Score for Price (28)

question: What are all the minimum requirements a proposer must meet in the City of Hartford Municipal Employees' Retirement Fund (MERF) general investment consultant RFP?
gold_answer: (1) In business at least 10 years providing general consulting services; (2) senior members (top leadership) have worked together at least 3 years; (3) no subcontracting of account management, and all account personnel must be employees of the proposer; (4) currently serve as consultant for at least five public pension funds each with over $1.5 billion in assets; (5) the primary consultant for MERF and OPEB has at least 5 years of consulting experience with DB public pension plans and has been employed by the proposer at least 3 years; (6) serve as a fiduciary to MERF and OPEB and acknowledge in writing compliance with their investment policies and guidelines. All must be met as of March 15, 2024, 5:00 p.m. ET.
gold_passage: The Proposer shall have been in business for at least ten (10) years providing general consulting services. • The senior members of the Proposer (those in top leadership positions) shall have worked together for at least three (3) years.
notes: Source is Section 2, Minimum Requirements. Appendix A restates them in slightly different wording.

question: List the core functions that the City of Creve Coeur Employee Pension Plan expects from its pension fund consultant in its May 2020 RFP.
gold_answer: (1) Help develop and maintain the investment policy statement; (2) plan asset allocations annually and monitor regularly; (3) recommend changes when markets change significantly and flag concerns; (4) provide research and recommendations for investments in each asset class; (5) follow recommended investments closely and meet the Pension Board quarterly in person, or monthly or as needed by phone; (6) provide monthly reporting of portfolio performance and statements; (7) work with City staff on sourcing funds, opening new accounts and tracking liquidity for pension payments; (8) work with investment managers, funds and custodians to ensure timely year-end and quarterly reporting.
gold_passage: Core functions • Help us to develop and maintain our investment policy statement. • Plan asset allocations annually and monitor regularly to keep us on track.
notes: The corpus also has a separate Creve Coeur Q&A file; the core functions list is in the RFP file.

question: Across the investment consultant RFPs in the corpus that set a minimum number of years in business or experience for the consulting firm, what is the most common minimum requirement?
gold_answer: Five years is the most common (4 RFPs), followed by ten years (3 RFPs). Per file: OCERS 5 years of continuous operation; COAERS 5 years in business (or senior principals with 10 years); SDCERS 5 years of continuous general investment consulting experience; Grand Rapids 5 years of institutional consulting experience; CTA 10 years in business; SC RSIC 10 years; Hartford MERF 10 years; SBCERA 7 years in existence; NYC BERS 7 years of experience; Boston BRS 3 years of experience. Several others (e.g. TMRS, Oklahoma TRS, Arizona PSPRS, IMRF, SFERS, Anchorage) set no firm-level years minimum; any year thresholds there apply only to individual consultants.
gold_passage: Respondent must have been in continuous operation for at least five (5) years providing services similar to those described in the Scope of Services.
notes: gold_passage is from OCERS only. Other supporting quotes: CTA 'the firm must have been in business at least ten years'; SC RSIC 'at least ten (10) years'; Hartford 'in business for at least ten (10) years'; SBCERA 'in existence for the past seven (7) years'; NYC BERS 'minimum of 7 (seven) years' experience'; Boston BRS 'at least three (3) years of experience'. Deciding which requirements are firm-level and which are individual-level takes judgement.
